changes.whyZh: 只是二氧化碳由固态直接变成气态，物质本身的成分没有改变，没有生成新物质。
changes.whyEn: Only the state changes from solid carbon dioxide straight to gas; the substance itself is unchanged and no new substance forms.

changes.whyZh: 紫色碘蒸气与固态碘是同一种物质，只是状态不同，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: The violet iodine vapour and the solid iodine are the same substance in different states, so no new substance is formed.

changes.whyZh: 蔗糖分子只是分散到水中形成溶液，溶质和溶剂本身都没有变成新物质。
changes.whyEn: The sugar molecules merely disperse through the water to form a solution; neither solute nor solvent becomes a new substance.

changes.whyZh: 只是铁钉的形状和位置发生改变，物质成分不变，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: Only the position and shape of the nails change; the composition is unchanged and no new substance is formed.

changes.whyZh: 固态石蜡受热变成液态，仍是石蜡，只是状态改变，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: Solid paraffin becomes liquid on heating but it is still paraffin, only the state changes and no new substance appears.

changes.zh: 水蒸气在玻璃上凝结成水珠
changes.en: Water vapour condensing into droplets on glass
changes.whyZh: 气态水变成液态水，水的成分没有改变，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: Gaseous water becomes liquid water; the composition is unchanged and no new substance is formed.

changes.whyZh: 分馏只是利用各组分的沸点不同分离出汽油、煤油等，分子本身没有被破坏，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: Fractional distillation separates gasoline, kerosene and the like purely by boiling point; the molecules are not broken down and no new substance forms.

changes.whyZh: 石墨依靠层间可以自由移动的电子导电，导电前后都是石墨，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: Graphite conducts through the mobile electrons between its layers; it is graphite before and after, so no new substance is produced.

changes.whyZh: 液态酒精变成酒精蒸气，仍是同一种物质，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: Liquid alcohol becomes alcohol vapour, still the same substance, and no new substance is formed.

changes.whyZh: 氯化钠以离子形式均匀分散到水中，溶质仍是氯化钠，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: Sodium chloride simply spreads through the water as ions; the solute remains sodium chloride and no new substance forms.

changes.whyZh: 只是铁丝的形状改变，物质的成分和性质都没有变，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: Only the shape of the wire changes; its composition and properties do not, so no new substance is formed.

changes.whyZh: 纸只是被分成了许多小块，成分没有改变，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: The paper is merely broken into smaller pieces; its composition is unchanged and no new substance is formed.

changes.whyZh: 自由电子在铜中定向移动，导电前后都是铜，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: Free electrons move directionally in the copper; it is copper before and after, so no new substance is produced.

changes.whyZh: 水蒸气冷凝后仍是水，只是把不挥发杂质留下了，没有生成新物质。
changes.whyEn: The vapour condenses back into water; only the non-volatile impurities are left behind, so no new substance is formed.

changes.whyZh: 食物在微生物作用下生成酸、酒精等新的物质，发生了化学变化。
changes.whyEn: Microbes convert the food into new substances such as acids and alcohol, so a chemical change has occurred.

changes.whyZh: 纸中的纤维素与氧气反应生成二氧化碳和水等新物质，属于化学变化。
changes.whyEn: The cellulose in the paper reacts with oxygen to form new substances such as carbon dioxide and water, so a chemical change occurs.

changes.whyZh: 酒精与氧气反应生成二氧化碳和水，燃烧后生成了新物质。
changes.whyEn: The alcohol reacts with oxygen to give carbon dioxide and water, so burning produces new substances.

changes.whyZh: 溶解的二氧化碳逸出形成气泡，同时碳酸分解生成水和二氧化碳，是化学变化。
changes.whyEn: Dissolved carbon dioxide escapes as bubbles as the carbonic acid decomposes into water and carbon dioxide, which is a chemical change.

changes.whyZh: 乳酸菌把牛奶中的糖分解成乳酸，产生了新物质，属于化学变化。
changes.whyEn: Bacteria ferment the sugars of the milk into lactic acid, producing a new substance, so a chemical change occurs.

changes.whyZh: 洋葱被切开时细胞破裂生成含硫化合物并与眼睛里的水反应，生成新物质。
changes.whyEn: Cutting ruptures the onion cells so that sulfur compounds are released and react with the water in the eyes, producing new substances.

changes.whyZh: 二氧化碳和水在光照和叶绿素作用下生成葡萄糖和氧气，生成了新物质。
changes.whyEn: Carbon dioxide and water are converted into glucose and oxygen under light and chlorophyll, so new substances are formed.

changes.en: Cellular respiration in the human body
changes.whyZh: 葡萄糖在酶的作用下与氧气反应生成二氧化碳和水，同时释放能量，属于化学变化。
changes.whyEn: Glucose reacts with oxygen under enzymes to give carbon dioxide and water and release energy, which is a chemical change.

changes.en: Iron reacting with copper sulfate solution
changes.whyZh: 铁把铜从硫酸铜中置换出来，生成硫酸亚铁和铜两种新物质。
changes.whyEn: Iron displaces copper from the copper sulfate solution, producing two new substances, iron(II) sulfate and copper.

changes.whyZh: 氢氧化钙与二氧化碳反应生成不溶于水的碳酸钙沉淀，出现了新物质。
changes.whyEn: Calcium hydroxide reacts with carbon dioxide to form insoluble calcium carbonate, so a new substance appears.

changes.en: Iron reacting with dilute sulfuric acid
changes.whyZh: 铁与稀硫酸反应生成硫酸亚铁和氢气，产生了新物质。
changes.whyEn: Iron reacts with dilute sulfuric acid to give iron(II) sulfate and hydrogen, so new substances are produced.

changes.whyZh: 煤中的碳与氧气反应生成二氧化碳并放热，是典型的化学变化。
changes.whyEn: The carbon in the coal reacts with oxygen to give carbon dioxide and heat, a typical chemical change.

changes.en: Electrolysis of brine to make hydrogen
changes.whyZh: 电能促使氯化钠和水分解，生成氢气、氯气和氢氧化钠，生成了新物质。
changes.whyEn: Electricity drives the decomposition of the brine, giving hydrogen, chlorine and sodium hydroxide, so new substances are formed.

changes.whyZh: 铁与氧气反应生成四氧化三铁，燃烧前后物质种类不同，属于化学变化。
changes.whyEn: Iron reacts with oxygen to give magnetite; the substance before and after burning is different, so a chemical change occurs.

changes.whyZh: 只是状态变了，固态的水变成液态的水，成分还是水，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: Only the state changed: solid water became liquid water. No new substance was formed.

changes.whyZh: 铁与氧气、水反应生成了新的物质（铁锈），有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: Iron reacted with oxygen and water to form a new substance (rust).

changes.whyZh: 只是形状变了，玻璃的成分没有变，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: Only the shape changed; the composition of the glass stayed the same.

changes.whyZh: 石蜡燃烧生成了二氧化碳和水，都是新物质。
changes.whyEn: The wax burned and produced carbon dioxide and water, both new substances.

changes.whyZh: 液态水变成水蒸气，只是状态变了，没有新物质生成。
changes.whyEn: Liquid water became vapour; only the state changed, no new substance was formed.

changes.whyZh: 果肉里的物质与空气中的氧气发生了反应，生成褐色的新物质。
changes.whyEn: Substances in the flesh reacted with oxygen from the air, forming a new brown substance.

balancedReactions.en: Hydrogen burning in oxygen
balancedReactions.whyZh: 氧原子个数必须为偶数，先把 H2O 的系数配成 2，氧原子随之有 2 个，O2 前也配 2，氢原子左右各 2 个，得 2∶1∶2。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Oxygen must come in an even count, so H2O takes 2; that needs 2 oxygen atoms, so O2 takes 2, and hydrogen is 2 on each side, giving 2:1:2.

balancedReactions.en: Carbon burning in oxygen
balancedReactions.whyZh: 一个碳原子与两个氧原子结合成 CO2，左右各 1 个碳和 2 个氧已相等，系数全为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: One carbon atom combines with two oxygen atoms to give CO2, so both sides already carry 1 C and 2 O and every coefficient is 1.

balancedReactions.en: Methane combustion
balancedReactions.whyZh: 先由碳定出 CO2 为 1，再数出 4 个氢原子要配 2 个 H2O，共需 4 个氧原子，故 O2 系数为 2。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Carbon fixes CO2 at 1; the 4 hydrogen atoms then need 2 H2O, which together require 4 oxygen atoms, so O2 takes 2.

balancedReactions.en: Ethanol combustion
balancedReactions.whyZh: 分子中有 2 个碳原子，故 CO2 配 2；有 6 个氢原子，故 H2O 配 3；右侧共 7 个氧原子，左侧酒精自带 1 个，故 O2 配 3。
balancedReactions.whyEn: The molecule holds 2 carbon atoms, so CO2 takes 2; its 6 hydrogen atoms make 3 H2O; the products then carry 7 oxygen atoms, one of which comes from ethanol, so O2 takes 3.

balancedReactions.zh: 铁在氧气中燃烧生成四氧化三铁
balancedReactions.en: Iron burning in oxygen to give magnetite
balancedReactions.whyZh: 生成物含 3 个铁原子和 4 个氧原子，故 Fe 前配 3、O2 前配 2，正好提供 4 个氧原子。
balancedReactions.whyEn: The product holds 3 iron and 4 oxygen atoms, so Fe takes 3 and O2 takes 2, supplying exactly those 4 oxygen atoms.

balancedReactions.zh: 铁与硫酸铜溶液反应（置换反应）
balancedReactions.en: Iron displacing copper from copper sulfate solution
balancedReactions.whyZh: 铁原子逐个把铜离子替换出来，硫酸根离子原样转移，左右各 1 个铁、1 个铜、1 个硫酸根，系数全为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Each iron atom displaces a copper ion while the sulfate ion is carried over unchanged, so 1 Fe, 1 Cu and 1 sulfate appear on each side and all coefficients are 1.

balancedReactions.en: Iron reacting with dilute sulfuric acid
balancedReactions.whyZh: 1 个铁原子把 2 个氢离子置换成 1 个氢分子，硫酸根留在铁上形成 FeSO4，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: One iron atom displaces two hydrogen ions to make one H2 molecule, while sulfate stays with iron as FeSO4, so all coefficients are 1.

balancedReactions.en: Zinc reacting with dilute sulfuric acid
balancedReactions.whyZh: 锌显 +2 价，硫酸根显 −2 价按 1∶1 结合成 ZnSO4，2 个氢原子生成 1 个氢分子，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Zinc is +2 and sulfate is −2, so they combine 1:1 as ZnSO4, and the two hydrogen atoms make one H2 molecule, giving all coefficients 1.

balancedReactions.en: Magnesium reacting with dilute hydrochloric acid
balancedReactions.whyZh: 镁显 +2 价需要 2 个氯离子，故 HCl 配 2；2 个氢原子生成 1 个氢分子，H2 系数为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Magnesium is +2 and needs two chloride ions, so HCl takes 2; the two hydrogen atoms give one H2 molecule, so H2 takes 1.

balancedReactions.en: Iron reacting with dilute hydrochloric acid
balancedReactions.whyZh: 铁与盐酸只能生成 +2 价的 FeCl2，需要 2 个氯原子故 HCl 配 2，氢原子两边各 2 个，H2 系数为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Iron with hydrochloric acid gives only +2 FeCl2, which needs two chlorine atoms, so HCl takes 2; hydrogen is 2 on each side and H2 takes 1.

balancedReactions.en: Sodium reacting with water
balancedReactions.whyZh: 2 个钠原子生成 2 个 NaOH 共需 2 个氧原子，故 H2O 配 2；这 2 个水分子里的 4 个氢原子中有 2 个进入 NaOH，另 2 个生成 1 个氢分子。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Two sodium atoms need two oxygen atoms for 2 NaOH, so H2O takes 2; of their four hydrogen atoms two go into the NaOH and the other two form one H2 molecule.

balancedReactions.zh: 生石灰与水反应生成熟石灰
balancedReactions.en: Quicklime reacting with water to form slaked lime
balancedReactions.whyZh: 氧化钙中 1 个钙原子、1 个氧原子加水后变成含 1 个钙、2 个氢氧根的 Ca(OH)2，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: The one calcium and one oxygen of CaO pick up water to give Ca(OH)2 with one calcium and two hydroxide groups, so all coefficients are 1.

balancedReactions.zh: 二氧化碳使澄清石灰水变浑浊
balancedReactions.en: Carbon dioxide turning clear limewater cloudy
balancedReactions.whyZh: 1 个 CO2 与 1 个 Ca(OH)2 结合成 1 个 CaCO3 沉淀并放出 1 个水分子，左右原子数相等，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: One CO2 combines with one Ca(OH)2 to give one CaCO3 precipitate and one water molecule, so the atom counts match with all coefficients 1.

balancedReactions.en: Calcium carbonate reacting with hydrochloric acid
balancedReactions.whyZh: 碳酸根要拆成 CO2 和水，1 个碳酸根含 1 个碳、3 个氧，生成 1 个 CO2 与 1 个水正好吻合；2 个氢原子需 2 个盐酸，氯原子进入 CaCl2。
balancedReactions.whyEn: The carbonate splits into CO2 and water: one carbonate carries 1 C and 3 O, which exactly fits one CO2 and one H2O; two hydrogen atoms need two HCl, and the chlorine goes into CaCl2.

balancedReactions.en: Limestone calcined at high temperature
balancedReactions.whyZh: 高温下碳酸钙分解成氧化钙和二氧化碳，1 个 CaCO3 恰好给出 1 个 CaO 和 1 个 CO2，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: At high temperature calcium carbonate splits into calcium oxide and carbon dioxide, and one CaCO3 gives exactly one CaO and one CO2, so all coefficients are 1.

balancedReactions.en: Sodium carbonate reacting with hydrochloric acid
balancedReactions.whyZh: 碳酸根给出 1 个 CO2 和 1 个水，2 个钠原子需要 2 个氯离子，故生成 2 个 NaCl，同时用掉 2 个盐酸。
balancedReactions.whyEn: The carbonate gives 1 CO2 and 1 H2O, and the two sodium atoms need two chloride ions, so 2 NaCl form while 2 HCl are consumed.

balancedReactions.zh: 氢氧化钠与盐酸的中和反应
balancedReactions.en: Neutralization of sodium hydroxide with hydrochloric acid
balancedReactions.whyZh: 酸碱中和按等量氢离子与氢氧根结合，1 个 NaOH 的 1 个氢氧根与 1 个盐酸的 1 个氢离子生成 1 个水分子，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: In neutralization equal amounts of H+ and OH- combine, so one hydroxide from NaOH with one hydrogen ion from HCl makes one water molecule and all coefficients are 1.

balancedReactions.en: Calcium hydroxide reacting with hydrochloric acid
balancedReactions.whyZh: 钙显 +2 价需要 2 个氯离子，故盐酸配 2；两个氢氧根各与一个氢离子结合生成 2 个水分子。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Calcium is +2 and needs two chloride ions, so HCl takes 2, and the two hydroxide groups each pair with one hydrogen ion to give two water molecules.

balancedReactions.zh: 二氧化碳与水反应生成碳酸
balancedReactions.en: Carbon dioxide reacting with water to form carbonic acid
balancedReactions.whyZh: 1 个二氧化碳分子加 1 个水分子正好构成 1 个碳酸分子，左右原子数一一对应，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: One carbon dioxide molecule plus one water molecule makes exactly one carbonic acid molecule, atom for atom, so all coefficients are 1.

balancedReactions.en: Decomposition of carbonic acid
balancedReactions.whyZh: 1 个碳酸分子中 1 个碳原子与 3 个氧原子重新分配成 1 个二氧化碳分子和 1 个水分子，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: In one carbonic acid molecule the carbon and three oxygen atoms rearrange into one CO2 and one H2O, so all coefficients are 1.

balancedReactions.en: Electrolysis of water
balancedReactions.whyZh: 氧原子个数必须为偶数，在 O2 前配 2，则需 4 个氧原子即 2 个水分子，这 2 个水分子共 4 个氢原子正好生成 2 个氢分子。
balancedReactions.whyEn: The oxygen count must be even, so O2 takes 2, which needs 4 oxygen atoms and hence 2 water molecules; their 4 hydrogen atoms give exactly 2 H2 molecules.

balancedReactions.en: Sulfur burning in oxygen
balancedReactions.whyZh: 1 个硫原子与 2 个氧原子结合成 1 个二氧化硫分子，左右原子数相等，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: One sulfur atom combines with two oxygen atoms to give one sulfur dioxide molecule, the counts already match, and all coefficients are 1.

balancedReactions.en: Magnesium burning in oxygen
balancedReactions.whyZh: 氧化镁中镁与氧为 1∶1，故镁前配 2 提供 2 个镁原子，氧气前也配 2 提供 2 个氧原子。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Magnesium and oxygen are 1:1 in MgO, so 2 Mg supply two magnesium atoms and 2 O2 supply the two oxygen atoms to match.

balancedReactions.en: Red phosphorus burning in oxygen
balancedReactions.whyZh: 五氧化二磷分子中有 2 个磷原子和 5 个氧原子，故 P 前配 4、P2O5 前配 2，氧原子共 10 个要由 5 个 O2 提供。
balancedReactions.whyEn: A P2O5 molecule holds 2 phosphorus and 5 oxygen atoms, so P takes 4 and P2O5 takes 2; the 10 oxygen atoms must come from 5 O2.

balancedReactions.zh: 氯酸钾受热分解制氧气
balancedReactions.en: Thermal decomposition of potassium chlorate to give oxygen
balancedReactions.whyZh: 氯酸钾中钾与氯为 1∶1，故 KClO3 与 KCl 同为 2；剩下 6 个氧原子组成 3 个 O2。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Potassium and chlorine are 1:1 in the chlorate, so KClO3 and KCl both take 2; the six remaining oxygen atoms form 3 O2.

balancedReactions.zh: 高锰酸钾受热分解制氧气
balancedReactions.en: Thermal decomposition of potassium permanganate to give oxygen
balancedReactions.whyZh: 先按钾原子把 KMnO4 与 K2MnO4 的系数配成 2 和 1，2 个锰原子一个进 K2MnO4、一个进 MnO2，8 个氧原子中余下的 2 个组成 1 个 O2。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Potassium fixes 2 KMnO4 against 1 K2MnO4; the two manganese atoms split between K2MnO4 and MnO2, and of the eight oxygen atoms the two left over form 1 O2.

balancedReactions.en: Decomposition of hydrogen peroxide
balancedReactions.whyZh: 过氧化氢中氢与氧为 1∶1，2 个 H2O2 含 4 个氢原子和 4 个氧原子，生成 2 个水分子后余 2 个氧原子组成 1 个 O2。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Hydrogen and oxygen are 1:1 in H2O2, so 2 H2O2 carry 4 H and 4 O; two water molecules use 2 O, leaving 2 O to form one O2.

balancedReactions.zh: 硝酸银与氯化钠生成氯化银沉淀
balancedReactions.en: Silver nitrate with sodium chloride forming a silver chloride precipitate
balancedReactions.whyZh: 银离子与氯离子按 1∶1 结合成 AgCl 沉淀，钠离子与硝酸根结合成 NaNO3，各元素左右守恒，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Silver and chloride ions pair 1:1 as the AgCl precipitate while sodium pairs with nitrate as NaNO3; every element balances with all coefficients 1.

balancedReactions.zh: 氯化钡与硫酸钠生成硫酸钡沉淀
balancedReactions.en: Barium chloride with sodium sulfate forming a barium sulfate precipitate
balancedReactions.whyZh: 钡离子与硫酸根按 1∶1 生成 BaSO4 沉淀，2 个钠原子则需 2 个氯离子，故 NaCl 配 2。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Barium and sulfate pair 1:1 as the BaSO4 precipitate, and the two sodium atoms need two chloride ions, so NaCl takes 2.

balancedReactions.en: Copper reacting with silver nitrate solution
balancedReactions.whyZh: 铜显 +2 价，每个铜原子要配 2 个硝酸根，故 AgNO3 取 2；2 个银离子被置换出 2 个银原子。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Copper is +2 and each atom needs two nitrate ions, so AgNO3 takes 2, and the two silver ions are displaced as two silver atoms.

balancedReactions.en: Sodium burning in chlorine
balancedReactions.whyZh: 钠显 +1 价、氯显 −1 价按 1∶1 结合，故 Na 与 Cl2 前都配 2，生成 2 个 NaCl。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Sodium is +1 and chlorine is −1, so they combine 1:1; Na and Cl2 both take 2 and 2 NaCl form.

balancedReactions.en: Combustion of ethene
balancedReactions.whyZh: 乙烯含 2 个碳原子，故 CO2 配 2；含 4 个氢原子，故 H2O 配 2；生成物共 6 个氧原子，乙烯自带 1 个，O2 配 3。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Ethene has 2 carbon atoms, so CO2 takes 2, and 4 hydrogen atoms, so H2O takes 2; the products carry 6 oxygen atoms and ethene supplies 1, so O2 takes 3.

balancedReactions.en: Combustion of acetylene
balancedReactions.whyZh: 先把碳原子配平：2 个 C2H2 含 4 个碳原子，故 CO2 配 4；再由 4 个氢原子得 H2O 配 2，共需 10 个氧原子，扣除生成物自带 2 个还差 8 个，故 O2 配 5。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Balance carbon first: 2 C2H2 hold 4 carbon atoms, so CO2 takes 4; the 4 hydrogen atoms then give 2 H2O; the products need 10 oxygen atoms and already carry 2, leaving 8 to be supplied by 5 O2.

balancedReactions.zh: 铝在氧气中燃烧生成氧化铝
balancedReactions.en: Aluminium burning in oxygen to give aluminium oxide
balancedReactions.whyZh: 氧化铝中铝与氧为 2∶3，故 Al 前配 4 提供 4 个铝原子，O2 前配 3 提供 6 个氧原子。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Aluminium and oxygen are 2:3 in Al2O3, so Al takes 4 to supply four aluminium atoms and O2 takes 3 to supply six oxygen atoms.

balancedReactions.zh: 氨与氯化氢反应生成氯化铵
balancedReactions.en: Ammonia reacting with hydrogen chloride to give ammonium chloride
balancedReactions.whyZh: 氨分子上的 1 个氮原子连同 3 个氢原子与 1 个氯化氢结合成 1 个氯化铵分子，左右原子数相等，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: The nitrogen of one ammonia molecule takes the three hydrogens plus the HCl to give one ammonium chloride, the counts already match and all coefficients are 1.

balancedReactions.en: Catalytic oxidation of ammonia
balancedReactions.whyZh: 先由氮定出 4 个 NH3 与 4 个 NO，氨共 12 个氢原子故 H2O 配 6，生成物共 10 个氧原子，氨中无氧，故 O2 配 5。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Nitrogen fixes 4 NH3 and 4 NO; the twelve hydrogen atoms then give 6 H2O; the products carry 10 oxygen atoms and ammonia has none, so O2 takes 5.

balancedReactions.zh: 一氧化氮被氧化成二氧化氮
balancedReactions.en: Oxidation of nitric oxide to nitrogen dioxide
balancedReactions.whyZh: 一氧化氮中氮显 +2 价，生成 +4 价的二氧化氮，每个氮原子需再得 1 个氧原子，故 2 个 NO 配 1 个 O2。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Nitrogen goes from +2 in NO to +4 in NO2, needing one extra oxygen atom each, so 2 NO take 1 O2.

balancedReactions.en: Nitrogen dioxide reacting with water
balancedReactions.whyZh: 由氮原子守恒，3 个 NO2 的 3 个氮原子分成 2 个硝酸和 1 个一氧化氮；氧原子左侧 3×2+1=7 个，右侧 2×3+1=7 个，氢原子 2 个也守恒。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Nitrogen balance splits the three N of 3 NO2 into 2 HNO3 and 1 NO; oxygen counts 3×2+1=7 on the left and 2×3+1=7 on the right, and the 2 hydrogen atoms balance too.

balancedReactions.zh: 三氧化硫与水反应生成硫酸
balancedReactions.en: Sulfur trioxide reacting with water to give sulfuric acid
balancedReactions.whyZh: 1 个三氧化硫分子加 1 个水分子恰好得到 1 个硫酸分子，左右各 1 个硫、4 个氧、2 个氢，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: One SO3 molecule plus one H2O molecule gives exactly one H2SO4, with 1 S, 4 O and 2 H on both sides, so all coefficients are 1.

balancedReactions.zh: 一氧化碳还原氧化铁炼铁
balancedReactions.en: Carbon monoxide reducing iron oxide to make iron
balancedReactions.whyZh: 氧化铁中 2 个铁原子被还原成 2 个铁原子，故 Fe2O3 与 Fe 系数相同取 1；3 个氧原子与 3 个一氧化碳结合生成 3 个二氧化碳。
balancedReactions.whyEn: The two iron atoms of Fe2O3 become two iron atoms, so Fe2O3 and Fe both take 1; the three oxygen atoms join three CO molecules to give three CO2.

balancedReactions.en: Iron oxide reacting with hydrochloric acid
balancedReactions.whyZh: 铁显 +3 价，2 个铁原子需 6 个氯离子，故盐酸配 6；6 个氢原子与氧化铁中的 3 个氧原子生成 3 个水分子。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Iron is +3, so the two iron atoms need six chloride ions and HCl takes 6; the six hydrogen atoms and the three oxygen atoms then form three water molecules.

balancedReactions.zh: 乙酸与氢氧化钠的中和反应
balancedReactions.en: Neutralization of acetic acid with sodium hydroxide
balancedReactions.whyZh: 乙酸给出 1 个氢离子与氢氧化钠的 1 个氢氧根结合成 1 个水分子，剩余的醋酸根与钠离子构成醋酸钠，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Acetic acid gives one hydrogen ion that pairs with one hydroxide to form one water molecule, and the remaining acetate pairs with sodium as the acetate salt, so all coefficients are 1.

balancedReactions.zh: 铵盐与碱反应放出氨气
balancedReactions.en: An ammonium salt reacting with a base to release ammonia
balancedReactions.whyZh: 铵根中的 4 个氢原子与 1 个氢氧根结合生成 1 个氨分子和 1 个水分子，钠离子与氯离子结合成 NaCl，系数均为 1。
balancedReactions.whyEn: The four hydrogens of the ammonium ion combine with one hydroxide to give one ammonia and one water molecule, while sodium pairs with chloride as NaCl, so all coefficients are 1.

balancedReactions.en: Copper reacting with concentrated sulfuric acid
balancedReactions.whyZh: 铜被氧化成 +2 价需配 1 个硫酸根，1 个硫酸分子中其余的硫被还原成二氧化硫，同时 2 个硫酸提供 4 个氧原子与 2 个铜反应生成 2 个水分子。
balancedReactions.whyEn: Copper is oxidised to +2 and needs one sulfate, while the sulfur of the other sulfuric acid is reduced to SO2; the two sulfuric acids supply four oxygen atoms that make two water molecules.

balancedReactions.en: Nitrogen and hydrogen combining to form ammonia
balancedReactions.whyZh: 配平后左边每个原子有 1 个，右边也是；系数要取最简整数比。
balancedReactions.whyEn: After balancing, both sides carry the same number of each atom; the coefficients must be the smallest whole numbers.

balancedReactions.zh: 铁在氧气中燃烧生成氧化铁
balancedReactions.en: Iron burning in oxygen to form iron(III) oxide
balancedReactions.whyZh: 配平后左边每个原子有 4 个，右边也是；系数要取最简整数比。
balancedReactions.whyEn: After balancing, both sides carry the same number of each atom; the coefficients must be the smallest whole numbers.

balancedReactions.en: Complete combustion of propane
balancedReactions.whyZh: 配平后左边每个原子有 1 个，右边也是；系数要取最简整数比。
balancedReactions.whyEn: After balancing, both sides carry the same number of each atom; the coefficients must be the smallest whole numbers.

phSubstances.whyZh: 胃液里含有盐酸，浓度大约是 0.01～0.1 mol/L，所以 pH 只有 2 左右；胃酸的强酸性正是它能帮助消化蛋白质的原因。
phSubstances.whyEn: Gastric juice contains hydrochloric acid at roughly 0.01–0.1 mol/L, which is why its pH is around 2; that strong acidity helps digest proteins.

phSubstances.whyZh: 柠檬汁里的柠檬酸等有机酸让它显酸性，pH 大约是 2；有机酸是弱酸，所以比同样 pH 的盐酸温和。
phSubstances.whyEn: Organic acids such as citric acid make lemon juice acidic at about pH 2; being weak acids they are far milder than hydrochloric acid at the same pH.

phSubstances.whyZh: 食醋的主要成分是醋酸，稀释后 pH 约 3，酸性比柠檬汁弱一点。
phSubstances.whyEn: Vinegar is mostly acetic acid; diluted it has a pH around 3, a little less acidic than lemon juice.

phSubstances.whyZh: 饮料里溶解的二氧化碳与水反应生成碳酸，所以显弱酸性，pH 约 3～4。
phSubstances.whyEn: The carbon dioxide dissolved in the drink forms carbonic acid, so it is mildly acidic at pH 3–4.

phSubstances.whyZh: 番茄含有柠檬酸、苹果酸等有机酸，所以 pH 略低于 7。
phSubstances.whyEn: Tomatoes contain citric and malic acids, which is why their juice sits just below neutral.

phSubstances.whyZh: 苹果里的苹果酸让果汁显酸性，pH 约 3～4。
phSubstances.whyEn: Malic acid in apples makes the juice acidic, around pH 3–4.

phSubstances.whyZh: 橙汁以柠檬酸为主，pH 和柠檬汁接近，约 3～4。
phSubstances.whyEn: Citric acid dominates orange juice, giving it a pH close to lemon juice, around 3–4.

phSubstances.whyZh: 雨水溶解了空气中的二氧化碳生成碳酸，所以正常雨水是弱酸性的，pH 约 5.6。
phSubstances.whyEn: Rainwater dissolves carbon dioxide from the air, which forms carbonic acid; unpolluted rain is therefore weakly acidic at about pH 5.6.

phSubstances.whyZh: 汗液里含有乳酸等代谢产物，所以略带酸性，pH 约 4～5。
phSubstances.whyEn: Sweat contains metabolic products such as lactic acid, so it is mildly acidic at around pH 4–5.

phSubstances.whyZh: 牛奶接近中性但略偏酸，pH 约 6.5～6.7；其中酪蛋白分解产生的乳酸让它偏酸。
phSubstances.whyEn: Milk is close to neutral but slightly acidic, pH 6.5–6.7; lactic acid from broken-down casein makes the difference.

phSubstances.whyZh: 25 ℃ 的纯水 pH 恰好是 7，因为水会微弱电离出等量的氢离子和氢氧根离子。
phSubstances.whyEn: Pure water at 25 °C has a pH of exactly 7, because water ionises very slightly into equal amounts of hydrogen and hydroxide ions.

phSubstances.whyZh: 自来水经过消毒并含有少量矿物质，通常呈弱碱性，pH 约 7～8.5。
phSubstances.whyEn: Tap water is disinfected and carries dissolved minerals, so it is usually mildly basic at pH 7–8.5.

phSubstances.whyZh: 矿泉水溶有多种矿物质，多数呈弱碱性，pH 约 7～8.5。
phSubstances.whyEn: Mineral water carries a range of dissolved minerals, most kinds mildly basic at pH 7–8.5.

phSubstances.whyZh: 血液靠碳酸氢盐缓冲体系把 pH 稳定在 7.35～7.45，略偏碱性。
phSubstances.whyEn: A bicarbonate buffer keeps blood pH between 7.35 and 7.45, slightly on the basic side.

phSubstances.whyZh: 海水中碳酸盐类含量较高，平均 pH 约 8.1，呈弱碱性。
phSubstances.whyEn: Seawater holds substantial carbonate, averaging about pH 8.1 — mildly basic.

phSubstances.whyZh: 小苏打是碳酸氢钠，它在水中水解出氢氧根离子，所以溶液显弱碱性。
phSubstances.whyEn: Baking soda is sodium hydrogencarbonate, which hydrolyses in water to give hydroxide ions, so the solution is mildly basic.

phSubstances.whyZh: 肥皂是高级脂肪酸盐，在水中水解使溶液显碱性，pH 通常在 9～10。
phSubstances.whyEn: Soap is a fatty acid salt; it hydrolyses in water, making the solution basic at roughly pH 9–10.

phSubstances.whyZh: 草木灰含碳酸钾等碱性成分，溶于水后溶液显碱性。
phSubstances.whyEn: Plant ash contains basic salts such as potassium carbonate, so its water extract is alkaline.

phSubstances.whyZh: 氨水是氨的水溶液，氨与水反应生成氢氧根离子，pH 约 11。
phSubstances.whyEn: Household ammonia is ammonia dissolved in water; ammonia reacts with water to give hydroxide ions, giving a pH near 11.

phSubstances.whyZh: 澄清石灰水是氢氧化钙的饱和溶液，虽然氢氧化钙微溶，但溶液显强碱性，pH 约 12。
phSubstances.whyEn: Clear limewater is a saturated calcium hydroxide solution. Calcium hydroxide is only slightly soluble, yet the solution is clearly basic at about pH 12.

phSubstances.whyZh: 氢氧化钠是强碱，在水中完全电离出氢氧根离子，pH 可达 13。
phSubstances.whyEn: Sodium hydroxide is a strong base and ionises completely to give hydroxide ions, reaching pH 13.

phSubstances.whyZh: 盐酸是强酸，在水中完全电离出氢离子，所以 pH 很低。
phSubstances.whyEn: Hydrochloric acid is a strong acid and ionises completely to give hydrogen ions, so its pH is very low.

phSubstances.whyZh: 硫酸是强酸，稀释后同样完全电离，pH 与同浓度的盐酸接近。
phSubstances.whyEn: Sulfuric acid is a strong acid; diluted it still ionises completely, so its pH matches hydrochloric acid of the same concentration.

phSubstances.whyZh: 碱石灰是氧化钙与氢氧化钠的混合物，两者都能与水反应生成碱，所以显强碱性。
phSubstances.whyEn: Soda lime is a mixture of calcium oxide and sodium hydroxide; both react with water to form a base, so it is strongly alkaline.

phSubstances.whyZh: 碳酸钠是盐，但碳酸根会水解产生氢氧根离子，所以水溶液显碱性，pH 约 11。
phSubstances.whyEn: Sodium carbonate is a salt, yet the carbonate ion hydrolyses to give hydroxide ions, so the solution is basic at about pH 11.

phSubstances.whyZh: 酸雨里溶了更多的二氧化硫和氮氧化物，形成的酸比正常雨水强，pH 小于 5.6。
phSubstances.whyEn: Acid rain carries more dissolved sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides, making it more strongly acidic than clean rain, with a pH below 5.6.

phSubstances.whyZh: 碳酸氢钠在水中水解，溶液显弱碱性，pH 约 8～9。
phSubstances.whyEn: Sodium hydrogencarbonate hydrolyses in water, so the solution is mildly basic at pH 8–9.

phSubstances.whyZh: 家用漂白水的主要成分是次氯酸钠，溶液显强碱性，pH 约 12～13；所以它绝不能和洁厕灵混用。
phSubstances.whyEn: Household bleach is mostly sodium hypochlorite and is strongly alkaline, pH 12–13, which is why it must never be mixed with toilet cleaner.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 钠显 +1 价、氯显 −1 价，按 1∶1 结合即可中和，写成 NaCl2 就多了一个氯原子。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Sodium is +1 and chlorine is −1, so they combine 1:1; writing NaCl2 adds one chlorine atom too many.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 钙显 +2 价、氯显 −1 价，需要两个氯离子才能配平电荷，正确式子是 CaCl2。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Calcium is +2 and chlorine is −1, so two chloride ions are needed to balance the charge; the correct formula is CaCl2.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 钡显 +2 价、氯显 −1 价，两个氯离子才能与一个钡离子配平，正确式子是 BaCl2。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Barium is +2 and chlorine is −1, so two chloride ions balance one barium ion; the correct formula is BaCl2.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 银显 +1 价、氯显 −1 价，按 1∶1 结合，正确式子是 AgCl。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Silver is +1 and chlorine is −1 and pair 1:1, so the correct formula is AgCl.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 铵根显 +1 价、氯显 −1 价，按 1∶1 结合，正确式子是 NH4Cl。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: The ammonium ion is +1 and chloride is −1, pairing 1:1, so the correct formula is NH4Cl.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 镁显 +2 价、氧显 −2 价，按 1∶1 结合，正确式子是 MgO。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Magnesium is +2 and oxygen is −2, combining 1:1, so the correct formula is MgO.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 钠显 +1 价、氢氧根显 −1 价，按 1∶1 结合，正确式子是 NaOH。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Sodium is +1 and the hydroxide group is −1, pairing 1:1, so the correct formula is NaOH.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 钙显 +2 价、氢氧根显 −1 价，需要两个氢氧根才能配平，正确式子是 Ca(OH)2。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Calcium is +2 and the hydroxide group is −1, so two hydroxide groups are needed; the correct formula is Ca(OH)2.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 铝显 +3 价、氢氧根显 −1 价，需要三个氢氧根才能配平，正确式子是 Al(OH)3。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Aluminium is +3 and hydroxide is −1, so three hydroxide groups are needed; the correct formula is Al(OH)3.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 碳酸根显 −2 价、钙显 +2 价，按 1∶1 结合且碳酸根本身是 C 与三个 O，正确式子是 CaCO3。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Carbonate is −2 and calcium is +2, combining 1:1, and the carbonate group is one C with three O; the correct formula is CaCO3.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 碳酸根显 −2 价、钠显 +1 价，需要两个钠离子才能配平，正确式子是 Na2CO3。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Carbonate is −2 and sodium is +1, so two sodium ions are needed to balance it; the correct formula is Na2CO3.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 镁显 +2 价、硫酸根显 −2 价，按 1∶1 结合，且硫酸根是 S 与四个 O，正确式子是 MgSO4。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Magnesium is +2 and sulfate is −2, pairing 1:1, and the sulfate group is one S with four O; the correct formula is MgSO4.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 铜显 +2 价、硫酸根显 −2 价，按 1∶1 结合，且硫酸根是 S 与四个 O，正确式子是 CuSO4。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Copper is +2 and sulfate is −2, pairing 1:1, and the sulfate group is one S with four O; the correct formula is CuSO4.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 铝显 +3 价、硫酸根显 −2 价，最简整数比为 2∶3，正确式子是 Al2(SO4)3。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Aluminium is +3 and sulfate is −2, so the smallest whole-number ratio is 2:3; the correct formula is Al2(SO4)3.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 钙显 +2 价、硝酸根显 −1 价，需要两个硝酸根，正确式子是 Ca(NO3)2。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Calcium is +2 and nitrate is −1, so two nitrate groups are needed; the correct formula is Ca(NO3)2.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 钾显 +1 价、硝酸根显 −1 价，按 1∶1 结合，且硝酸根是 N 与三个 O，正确式子是 KNO3。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Potassium is +1 and nitrate is −1, pairing 1:1, and the nitrate group is one N with three O; the correct formula is KNO3.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 磷酸根显 −3 价、钾显 +1 价，最简整数比为 3∶1，正确式子是 K3PO4。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Phosphate is −3 and potassium is +1, so the smallest whole-number ratio is 3:1; the correct formula is K3PO4.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 铁锈中的铁显 +3 价、氧显 −2 价，最简整数比为 2∶3，正确式子是 Fe2O3 而不是 FeO。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: In rust the iron is +3 and oxygen is −2, so the smallest whole-number ratio is 2:3; the correct formula is Fe2O3, not FeO.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 钾显 +1 价、高锰酸根显 −1 价，按 1∶1 结合，且高锰酸根是 Mn 与四个 O，正确式子是 KMnO4。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Potassium is +1 and permanganate is −1, pairing 1:1, and the permanganate group is one Mn with four O; the correct formula is KMnO4.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 硫在二氧化硫中显 +4 价、氧显 −2 价，按 1∶2 结合，正确式子是 SO2。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Sulfur is +4 in the compound and oxygen is −2, so they combine 1:2; the correct formula is SO2.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 钠显 +1 价、氯显 −1 价，按 1∶1 结合，应写作 NaCl。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Na is +1 and Cl is −1, so they combine 1:1: NaCl.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 钙显 +2 价、氯显 −1 价，按 1∶2 结合，应写作 CaCl2。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Ca is +2 and Cl is −1, so they combine 1:2: CaCl2.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 镁显 +2 价、氯显 −1 价，按 1∶2 结合，应写作 MgCl2。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Mg is +2 and Cl is −1, so they combine 1:2: MgCl2.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 钠显 +1 价、氧显 −2 价，按 2∶1 结合，应写作 Na2O。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Na is +1 and O is −2, so they combine 2:1: Na2O.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 铝显 +3 价、氧显 −2 价，按 2∶3 结合，应写作 Al2O3。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Al is +3 and O is −2, so they combine 2:3: Al2O3.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 铁显 +3 价、氧显 −2 价，按 2∶3 结合，应写作 Fe2O3。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Fe is +3 and O is −2, so they combine 2:3: Fe2O3.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 碳酸根是 CO3（−2 价），与 +2 价的钙按 1∶1 结合，应写作 CaCO3。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Carbonate is CO3 (−2), which pairs 1:1 with Ca (+2): CaCO3.

wrongFormulas.whyZh: 镁显 +2 价、氧显 −2 价，按 1∶1 结合，应写作 MgO。
wrongFormulas.whyEn: Mg is +2 and O is −2, so they combine 1:1: MgO.
